outreach-172.text: ACY support team is the best service team among all the trading platforms I experienced, as helpful Michael from the centre solved my trading software problem by effort, this time customer manager Fay provided me the opportunity to attend the useful investment seminar in Brisbane and helped me upgrade my trading platform. Highly recommend ACY Securities

I am very happy to deal with this broker. It is the best and offers very good offers, follow-up from the account manager, beautiful offers, and their technical support is very cooperative. I thank Hussam Alzagha, who is from the technical support, for his wonderful cooperation.

Their level of dedication and passion has impressed me. They are firmly committed to the success and happiness of their clients. Additionally, there is always open and honest communication with them. Working with them was a marvelous experience because of their customer-centric approach.

ACY Securities supposed to be No. 1 worldwide without talking a lot about them, will mention just one thing, withdrawal process takes them from one to 4 hours maximum according to 3 years experience with them ...

I really appreciate the professional support I receive from the team, especially Yazeed. He is always available, answers my questions clearly, and makes sure everything is handled quickly and smoothly. I would also like to thank Baha for the careful account management and follow up, which gives me confidence while I trade with ACY.
